description:
List NF-e documents other companies issued against this one.

The mirror of list_invoices: that one shows what this company issued,
this one what it received. Read-only.

It reads what the API already collected and never calls the tax
authority, which caps how often a company may ask per day. Each row
carries the issuer, the amount and, once one was filed, the
manifestation. Before a manifestation the authority sends a summary
only; the full document arrives after one.

company_id.description: UUID of the company this call acts for. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

company_tax_id.description: CNPJ or CPF of the company this call acts for, never the recipient or a taxpayer being looked up. Omit it when the connection covers a single company; with several it is required (see list_authorized_companies). Send company_id or company_tax_id, never both.

offset.description: Rows to skip, for the next page: offset + limit.

name: list_received_invoices

ReceivedItem.description: One document another company issued against this one.

issuer_name.description: Who issued it against this company.

manifestation.description: The position already filed, when there is one. Before a manifestation the authority sends a summary only.

outputSchema.description: A page of documents issued against this company, newest first.
